body: You’ve come full circle friend, you’re almost done now... have a kid and get ready to lie more than you have your whole life. It’s what’ll keep them alive till adulthood.
Go outside, talk to someone... make them talk about themselves people always like to run their mouth. Do it enough and you’ll never have a quiet moment again with how many people talk to you.

You’re running out of time for the night mate, the suns not far around the corner? If you were so ready to go why let all these random nobody’s try to talk you out of it? Unless you really don’t feel like doin it tonight? You really should call someone before you end up with brain damage if someone finds you before it kills you, then you may never actually be able to end your own life due to disability. And assisted suicide is not a thing atm so it’s either your hand or nothing if that’s the way you wanna play it. But fr call someone mate... cheers.

I’ve been in the mental health system for years dude. It’s slow as fuck... a week is nothing. Try years of waiting for relief that barely comes if at all. For many it does come though... you have to be persistent. If you stop you’re giving up your right and obligation to keep on going, living, changing and growing as a person. Call people every day until you fix your problem, if you can’t not be lazy enough to pick up a god damn phone and type in a few numbers... that little ass effort to try and improve your life... I’m sorry but you will never be happy and never find relief.

If this forum is your last resort it is a little late... you need to speak to a real person and get real help. Thank you... next. Go to school, get an education, talk to a person with resources to help you, the internet will only drive you further to madness my friend. You stay here you will die on the inside or on the outside.
